assumptions: mdsi = gmsd::mdsi_rgb8 -> mdsi::run -> score_with (mdsi.rs:758-790, lib.rs:499-505). Paper-transcription; all similarity work f64.

Downsample (mdsi.rs:80-98, 164-206, 372-427): M = max(1, round(min(w,h)/256)); exact integer box average + decimate, 3 channels: vertical int window sums ~1 int add per input px per channel (u16/u32 accumulators), horizontal window M adds per out px per channel + 1 div by M^2 each.

Colour planes (prepare_rows, mdsi.rs:427-497): per output px per image: L = 0.2989R+0.5870G+0.1140B (3mul+2add) + Gaussian chromaticity H,M (each ~ 3mul+2add+sub; counted 6 mul + 6 add) + int->f64 cvt x3; fused F=(Lr+Ld)/2 is folded into the plane array as plane index 2 (mul1 add1).

similarity_row per map elem (mdsi.rs:564-628): three inline Prewitt gradients (each: 3x3 zero-pad, gx/gy via 6 subs + ~5 adds + t-mul, mag sqrt -> mul3 add11 sqrt1 ~load10), gs/gs_rf/gs_df similarity terms (each 2ab+c / a^2+b^2+c -> mul4 add3 div1), gs_c combine, chromaticity cv (mul6 add5 div1), q = a*gs_c + (1-a)*cv (mul2 add1).
pool (mdsi.rs:701-756): per elem complex fourth root (sqrt x2 + ~4 ops) + 2 mean adds + deviation (sub2 mul2 add1 sqrt1) + final quarter_pow on the mean.
Windows use reflect-free edge clamps (window() range truncation); counted as full-M interior.
Map dims OW x OH at the M-decimated grid; halo from 3x3 gradients is 1 in map-px = M original px.

stages.name: integer vertical window sums (u16/u32), 3 ch
stages.notes: each input px enters one out row's column sums (windowed)

stages.name: horizontal window sums + /M^2 + colour planes
stages.notes: per out px per ch: M int adds + div; then L/H/M colour (mul3 add3 cvt1 folded) — L needs all 3 ch so transform counted once here

stages.name: complex fourth-root deviation pooling
stages.notes: fourth_root -> (re,im) 2 sqrt + trig-const fold ~4; means 2 adds; deviation sub2+mul2+add1+sqrt; final quarter_pow once
